background: Vanquis Banking Group is a UK specialist lender to customers underserved by mainstream banks, funded by retail savings and lending through credit cards, vehicle finance under Moneybarn and personal loans.
synthesis: Only one of the three main agencies rates the group, at BB-, below investment grade, on a positive outlook. Against UK small banks CET1 of 15.6% is below the peer median and leverage of 10.7% at it, while LCR of 280% and NSFR of 143% are both below the median. The trend is down: since 30 Jun 2024 CET1 has fallen 4.2 points, leverage 4.7 points and LCR 806 points, in figures to 30 Jun 2026.
